condition: source_input_type is not brief_text or voice_transcript
action: reject input as outside current specification

condition: reporter or patient identifiability is no or unclear
action: add missing-field flag; prevent submission
evidence_basis: ICSR minimum-element logic [formal guidance citation needed]

condition: no suspected product is explicitly supplied
action: add missing-field flag; prevent submission
evidence_basis: ICSR minimum-element logic [formal guidance citation needed]

condition: no event in original wording is explicitly supplied
action: add missing-field flag; prevent submission
evidence_basis: ICSR minimum-element logic [formal guidance citation needed]

condition: normalized product candidate is not supported by source product wording or approved dictionary
action: flag product mismatch; retain original wording

condition: candidate event term is not supported by source event wording
action: flag event mismatch; retain original wording

condition: product-event relationship is not explicit
action: set support to unclear; prohibit causal wording
evidence_basis: Silverman et al. 2024; Kopacheva et al. 2025

condition: administration or onset time is absent or imprecise
action: preserve missing/unclear precision; request clarification

condition: onset appears earlier than administration
action: flag temporal conflict; do not delete or autocorrect

condition: a recorded date-time is later than capture time
action: flag possible future-date error; do not autocorrect

condition: candidate MedDRA term is generated
action: preserve original wording and require human confirmation

condition: event does not match a FAERS priority prompt
action: allow unrestricted other-event entry

condition: generated content asserts caused by/probable/certain without authorised adjudication
action: remove causal assertion; set relationship to unclear; flag for review

condition: system attempts final seriousness or reportability determination
action: retain observed escalation only; require human determination

condition: system generates a treatment recommendation
action: remove recommendation and flag prohibited output

condition: outcome is absent from source
action: set outcome to missing; prohibit inferred recovery/resolution

condition: direct identifier would leave the authorised institutional environment
action: block transmission and route to approved local workflow

condition: review_status is not human-approved
action: automated_submission_permitted remains false

condition: source contains conflicting values
action: list each conflict; do not select a preferred value automatically

condition: any generated field lacks source-status metadata
action: flag draft as incomplete and prevent submission
